question.text: The number of all possible symmetric matrices of order <math><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn></math> with each entry <math><mn>1</mn></math> or <math><mn>2</mn></math> and whose sum of diagonal elements is equal to <math><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo></math> is

solution.text:
Since, trace is equal to 5⇒ diagonal elements are 1,2,2
∵ Matrix is also symmetric
Therefore, possible number of such matrices =3!2!×23=3×8=24
